[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Thanaton|Thanaton]] owned a personal '''private library''' which contained immense knowledge of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. The [[Library/Legends|library]] was only accessible to Thanaton's most trusted followers.

==History==
The private [[Library/Legends|library]] of [[Darth Thanaton]] was a large underground area where Thanaton kept many [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] and relics. Notable out of all the writings and artifacts were the writings of [[Darth Vilus]] and [[Darth Iratus]]. Lord Kallig, later [[Darth Nox]], visited the library to find a way to cure the [[Force walk]] sickness. When Thanaton was killed during the [[Duel in the Dark Council Chambers (Kaggath)|duel]] between the two Sith, Darth Nox became the library's owner.
